@graph.name: Space BQS Mobile App
@graph.description: Offline-first mobile application for marine bunker quantity surveyors. Enables direct onboard sounding capture, water cut deductions, tank temperature entry, vessel QR identification, and 72-hour autonomous offline lease with automatic cryptographic sync upon reconnection.
featureList: 72-Hour Full Offline Operation in Steel Holds and Anchorages
QR Vessel Profile Scan for Automated Tank Calibration Tables
Sounding and Ullage Mode Toggles with Free Water Cuts
Immediate Local Validation of Density at 15°C and Temperature Inputs

offers.description: Included with enterprise survey firm team license
